method: Actual unrendered game tick, 60Hz; fixed tier snapshots, earn/apply first offered upgrades; deterministic nearest-threat tangential dodge with stationary 1.6s per 7s. 39s early/mid/late windows, finale up to 180s. Host times are NOT browser FPS.
limitations: One gameplay seed and one economy seed, representative fixed build snapshots, not a full human campaign playthrough.
LAB retains its stress-mode equipment, run scale, disabled hazards and milestone setup; campaign retains its normal mode rules. Compare builds within each mode.
Uptime is measured productive acting time / observed follower simulation time; turret productive time is reported separately. Zero casts remain zero.
Host simulation timings are not Chrome FPS. No browser screenshots or recordings claimed.
